name: Devilicious

features.name: Wheel-set free spins
features.description: Up to 20 spins with a 2x or 3x multiplier.

review:
Devilicious takes place outside the gates of hell on a 5x3 grid. Nine money bags with spears pay 1,000x immediately when they land.

Three blue horned hearts start free spins, where a wheel of fortune sets a random number of up to 20 spins and a 2x or 3x multiplier. A respin feature is randomly awarded when enough 'hot lips' wilds are visible, and more wilds add more respins. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.46%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
